tool_schemas.name: findParks
tool_schemas.description: Searches and lists parks matching the provided free-text and filters (state_codes, designation, status), returning a page of park summaries sorted as requested. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums, limit out of range, or malformed inputs; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to query parks; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

state_codes.description: Filter parks by one or more 2-letter state/territory codes.

designation.description: Filter parks by designation (e.g., 'National Park', 'National Monument').

limit.description: Maximum number of parks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getParkDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for a single park, looked up by either park_id (internal id) or park_code (NPS park code). If both identifiers are provided, they must refer to the same park. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if park_id does not match the required format; NOT_FOUND if no park matches the identifier(s); CONFLICT if park_id and park_code refer to different parks; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

tool_schemas.name: getAlerts
tool_schemas.description: Lists alerts (closures, hazards, weather, etc.) optionally scoped to a park and filtered by category, severity, status, and/or whether the alert is active as of a point in time (active_only with optional as_of). Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit alerts ordered by sort and a next cursor when additional pages exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed park_id, invalid enums, invalid date-time values, or limit out of range; NOT_FOUND if park_id is provided but does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

park_id.description: Return alerts for a specific park (parks.id).

active_only.description: If true, only return alerts currently in effect based on effective window.

as_of.description: Point-in-time used with active_only to evaluate effective window.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getVisitorCenters
tool_schemas.description: Lists visitor centers, optionally scoped to a park, including their operating status/hours, sorted as requested. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit visitor centers and a next cursor when more results are available; pass cursor to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed park_id, invalid status/sort values, or limit out of range; NOT_FOUND if park_id is provided but does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

park_id.description: Return visitor centers for a specific park (parks.id).

status.description: Filter visitor centers by operating status.

limit.description: Maximum number of visitor centers to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getCampgrounds
tool_schemas.description: Lists campgrounds and key amenities, optionally scoped to a park and filtered by operating status and minimum campsite count. Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit campgrounds sorted as requested and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed park_id, invalid enums, negative min_campsites_count, or limit out of range; NOT_FOUND if park_id is provided but does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

park_id.description: Return campgrounds for a specific park (parks.id).

min_campsites_count.description: Filter campgrounds to those with at least this many campsites.

limit.description: Maximum number of campgrounds to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getEvents
tool_schemas.description: Lists park events, optionally scoped to a park and filtered by lifecycle status and start time window (starts_after/starts_before). Results are cursor-paginated: we return up to limit events ordered by sort and a next cursor when additional pages exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed park_id, invalid enums, invalid date-time values, an invalid time range (starts_after after starts_before), or limit out of range; NOT_FOUND if park_id is provided but does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access; and RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds its request quota.

park_id.description: Return events for a specific park (parks.id).

starts_after.description: Only return events with start_at on/after this timestamp.

starts_before.description: Only return events with start_at on/before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: createParkAlert
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new alert for a park. The new alert is validated for required fields, foreign key integrity (park_id must exist), and lifecycle defaults (status must be a valid value). Returns the created alert. Refuses requests with VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs or invalid effective window; NOT_FOUND if park_id does not reference an existing park; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access credentials; FORBIDDEN when the API consumer is suspended/revoked; RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds their requests_per_minute_limit.

effective_start_at.description: Timestamp when the alert becomes effective.

effective_end_at.description: Optional timestamp when the alert stops being effective; must be >= effective_start_at when both are provided.

source_url.description: Optional source URL for the alert (press release, incident page, etc.).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the alert.

tool_schemas.name: updateParkStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates a park's lifecycle status using an allowed transition (active↔inactive, or active/inactive→archived). Returns the updated park. Refuses INVALID_TRANSITION when attempting to skip or violate the lifecycle graph; NOT_FOUND when the park does not exist or is archived and therefore not addressable; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access credentials; FORBIDDEN when the API consumer is suspended/revoked; RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds their requests_per_minute_limit.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the park; must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: updateAlertStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates an alert's lifecycle status using an allowed transition (active→expired/cancelled/archived; expired/cancelled→archived). Returns the updated alert. Refuses INVALID_TRANSITION when attempting to skip or violate the lifecycle graph; NOT_FOUND when the alert does not exist; UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access credentials; FORBIDDEN when the API consumer is suspended/revoked; RATE_LIMITED when the consumer exceeds their requests_per_minute_limit.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the alert; must be a valid transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: getCurrentConsumer
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API consumer associated with the presented API key, including its status, effective rate limit, and current window usage when available. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid access credentials; FORBIDDEN when the API consumer is suspended/revoked.

include_quota.description: If true, include current rate-limit window usage/remaining when available.

metadata.description: This backend stores National Park entities and the operational content users query: alerts, visitor centers, campgrounds, and events.
